beats.headline: Named on the recap
beats.text: A woman with a crossbow and an ever-growing crowd of female warriors, killing their way through the dungeon. They have named themselves Brynhild's Daughters. The leader is Hekla, and the announcer gives a short history of her home country, Iceland. The AI is throwing loot at her to fit the shieldmaiden persona, including a glittering breastplate better suited to the cover of a harem fantasy novel than to a dungeon. Donut thinks they should join up. Carl suspects he would not be welcome.

beats.headline: They carry her as far as they can
beats.text: A neighbourhood boss and a borough boss with Katia in tow, until the third floor scatters everyone on arrival and she is too far from the rest of them to share in the experience.

beats.headline: Thirty in the Royal Court's space
beats.text: Thirty of them, most around level twenty-five with Hekla at thirty-three, get through the employee portal at substation H after Sadie casts Glass Prison on its Kravyad. They hike to station sixty, find a switch there onto any of twelve Homeward Bound platforms, and turn up inside the Royal Court's personal space, because Katia holds a space attached to it and has whitelisted every one of them. Their own two combined spaces cannot take visitors until they buy a third. They ride to station sixty clinging to the outside of Carl's train.

beats.headline: Leaderless on a train
beats.text: With Hekla dead, party leadership passes automatically to Eva. People do not like Eva, and they start leaving. The Daughters have hardly any equipment and no personal space any more. Most of them share Hekla's sponsor, a crab ranch, which has never sent them anything. The healer Silfa came in with her own two daughters, the mages at the engine door, who had Hekla's orders to kill Carl first if anything went wrong. Brynhild's Daughters, as Silfa puts it, is no more.
